### U.S. Policy Momentum Signals a Reshaped Critical Minerals Landscape - and Odyssey is Ready


February 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/296607287/files/doc_news/2026/02/1/U-S-Policy-Momentum-Signals-a-Reshaped-Critical-Minerals-Landscape-and-Odyssey-is-Ready.pdf)


Dear Stakeholders,


I wanted to make sure you had a chance to see the[blog](https://www.odysseymarine.com/blog1) we posted last week highlighting recent U.S. policy initiatives that point to a clear shift in how the U.S. and its allies are approaching critical minerals. From U.S.–Mexico coordination on phosphate, to Project Vault, to the new U.S.–Cook Islands framework, the direction is consistent: more secure, transparent, and allied‑aligned supply chains. As we note in the blog, Odyssey’s portfolio is already aligned with the regions, minerals, and science this policy architecture prioritizes.


More updates soon as this momentum continues.


Best regards,


**Mark Gordon**
CEO & Chairman of the Board
Odyssey Marine Exploration
